project_info.theme: Galaxy S25 Ultra battery life performance poster
project_info.color_palette: Black, white, silver, dusk city lights, cyan-blue highlight text, red video progress bar

main_subject.detail: Black-background battery-life ad featuring a horizontal Galaxy S25 Ultra displaying a city skyline video player, paired with large battery and playback duration metrics beneath.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic premium tech advertising, minimal launch infographic, polished product render

composition_elements.text: Extraordinary battery life / Galaxy S25 Ultra / Galaxy AI / 5000 mAh / Video playback up to 31 hrs
items: Top Left: Large centered white title 'Extraordinary battery life'.
Top Right: Centered subheading 'Galaxy S25 Ultra' and 'Galaxy AI'.
Bottom Left: Blue battery icon and metric '5000 mAh'.
Bottom Right: White and blue text 'Video playback up to 31 hrs'.

Center/Background: Horizontal silver Galaxy S25 Ultra showing a dusk city skyline in a video player with a large white play button overlay, a red progress bar, thumbnail scrub strip, '30:30 / 31:00' at bottom right of the screen, and a small circular '100' badge at top right of the display; long legal footnote copy runs along the bottom of the poster.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean metallic reflections, subtle screen glow, crisp contrast between black field and bright UI elements

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy S25 Ultra battery life performance poster. Centerpiece is a horizontal silver Galaxy S25 Ultra on a pure black background, displaying a dusk skyline video player with a large play icon, red progress bar, timeline thumbnails, '30:30 / 31:00', and a small '100' badge. Background is minimal black with strong premium reflections. Surrounding elements: exact title 'Extraordinary battery life', subheading 'Galaxy S25 Ultra' and 'Galaxy AI', bottom metrics '5000 mAh' and 'Video playback up to 31 hrs', and a dense white legal footnote paragraph along the lower edge. Technical style: photorealistic product render, studio lighting, clean metallic reflections and subtle screen glow, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra horizontal device render
assets.source: official Samsung renders or original creative
assets.usage: Match bezel shape, frame finish, and horizontal orientation.

assets.name: video player interface on screen
assets.usage: Preserve the skyline video frame, play icon, timeline thumbnails, progress bar, and duration numbers.

assets.name: battery metric typography and footnotes
assets.usage: Keep the exact metric wording, colors, and long bottom disclaimer block.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use refs for the phone render and on-screen player UI. Keep the product centered low in the composition with a large empty black header, because the spare negative space is part of the premium Samsung launch language.
